nvitk.io.writers¶

Writers for NIfTI, TIFF, MetaImage, and PIL-supported formats (used by nvitk.io.imsave()).

Submodules¶

  • nvitk.io.writers.mha
  • nvitk.io.writers.nifti
  • nvitk.io.writers.pil
  • nvitk.io.writers.tiff

Functions¶

write_mha(→ None)

Save data as .mha / .mhd; expects ZYX (or reordered) for 3D volumes.

write_nifti(→ None)

Save data to path as NIfTI; writes a sibling .json when extra metadata is JSON-safe.

write_pil(→ None)

Write raster image; floats are scaled to uint8 when needed.

write_tiff(→ None)

Save data to path as TIFF; reorders axes when metadata contains axes and axes differs.

nvitk.io.writers.write_mha(path: str, data: Any, *, axes: str | None = None, metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None, **kwargs: Any) → None¶

nvitk.io.writers.write_nifti(path: str, data: Any, *, axes: str | None = None, metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None, save_metadata_extension: bool = True, **_: Any) → None¶

Save data to path as NIfTI; writes a sibling .json when extra metadata is JSON-safe.

Reorders from metadata['axes'] to axes when both differ. Zooms come from x_res / y_res / z_res / t_res (or aliases). With save_metadata_extension=True, a nibabel header extension may embed additional JSON metadata.
